verdicts.title: Brauer spaces for commutative rings and structured ring spectra
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Using an analogy between the Brauer groups in algebra and the Whitehead groups in topology, we first use methods of algebraic K-theory to give a natural definition of Brauer spectra for commutative rings, such that their homotopy groups are given by the Brauer group, the Picard group and the group of units. Then, in the context of structured ring spectra, the same idea leads to two-fold non-connected deloopings of the spectra of units.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Brauer spectra for commutative rings and structured ring spectra via algebraic K-theory analogies with Whitehead groups, with no mention of Boolean circuits, monotone width, or any complexity-theoretic notion. It shares only the 'Brauer group' vocabulary without interacting with the conjecture's specific claim.

verdicts.title: Functorial, operadic and modular operadic combinatorics of circuit algebras
